description:
Full AI agent lifecycle platform — create, grade, optimize, deploy and orchestrate AI agents from your IDE or terminal.

## What you can do

- **Build** — Create agents from 37 templates or custom system prompts, with skills, tools and extensions
- **Grade** — Evaluate agent quality with 6 criteria (output match, schema validation, tool usage, safety, custom scripts, LLM judge)
- **Optimize** — AutoResearch lab with 6 modes: AutoTune, AutoFix, Stress Lab, Tournament, Distillation, Evolution
- **Deploy** — Widget, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, webhooks (n8n/Zapier/Make compatible)
- **Orchestrate** — Multi-agent teams with parallel, sequential and conditional execution modes
- **Monitor** — Usage tracking, session history, compliance reports (EU AI Act)

## 32 tools in 6 categories

| Category | Tools |
|----------|-------|
| Agent CRUD | create, get, update, delete, list, import, export |
| Templates | list templates, deploy template |
| Grading | grade prompt, create suite, run grading,

detail.description:
Full AI agent lifecycle platform — create, grade, optimize, deploy and orchestrate AI agents from your IDE or terminal.

## What you can do

- **Build** — Create agents from 37 templates or custom system prompts, with skills, tools and extensions
- **Grade** — Evaluate agent quality with 6 criteria (output match, schema validation, tool usage, safety, custom scripts, LLM judge)
- **Optimize** — AutoResearch lab with 6 modes: AutoTune, AutoFix, Stress Lab, Tournament, Distillation, Evolution
- **Deploy** — Widget, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, webhooks (n8n/Zapier/Make compatible)
- **Orchestrate** — Multi-agent teams with parallel, sequential and conditional execution modes
- **Monitor** — Usage tracking, session history, compliance reports (EU AI Act)

## 32 tools in 6 categories

| Category | Tools |
|----------|-------|
| Agent CRUD | create, get, update, delete, list, import, export |
| Templates | list templates, deploy template |
| Grading | grade prompt, create suite, run grading, list runs, get results |
| Optimization | run AutoResearch |
| Deployment | connect widget, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, webhooks, email, calendar |
| Orchestration | create team, run team, create pipeline, run pipeline |

## 3 guided workflows (prompts)

- **create-agent** — Step-by-step agent creation from use case to deployment
- **grade-and-improve** — Evaluate and auto-optimize an existing agent
- **deploy-everywhere** — Multi-channel deployment assistant

## Getting started

1. Sign up free at [kopern.ai](https://kopern.ai)
2. Go to Settings → Personal API Key
3. Connect this MCP server with your `kpn_` key

key.description: Kopern API key (starts with kpn_). Get yours at https://kopern.ai → Settings → Personal API Key

tools.name: kopern_list_templates
tools.description: List all 37 AI agent templates (28 general + 9 vertical/business). Returns slug, title, domain, tagline. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_list_agents
tools.description: List all your Kopern agents (name, description, model, domain, grading score). No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_grade_prompt
tools.description: Grade a system prompt against inline test cases. Uses 6 criteria types (output_match, schema_validation, tool_usage, safety_check, custom_script, llm_judge). Returns score 0-1. Uses YOUR API keys.

tools.name: kopern_create_agent
tools.description: Create a new AI agent with a system prompt, model, and optional skills. Returns the agentId.

builtin_tools.description: Built-in tools to enable: web_fetch, memory, github_read, github_write, bug_management, datagouv, piste, service_email, service_calendar

tools.name: kopern_get_agent
tools.description: Get full details of an agent: system prompt, model, skills count, tools count, grading suites count.

tools.name: kopern_update_agent
tools.description: Update an agent's configuration (name, system prompt, model, builtin tools, etc.).

provider.description: LLM provider (anthropic, openai, google, mistral, ollama)

builtin_tools.description: Built-in tools to enable: web_fetch, memory, github_read, github_write, bug_management, datagouv, piste, service_email, service_calendar

tools.name: kopern_delete_agent
tools.description: Permanently delete an agent and all its data (skills, tools, grading suites, sessions, connectors).

tools.name: kopern_deploy_template
tools.description: Deploy an agent from a template (28 general + 9 vertical). Creates agent + skills + tools + grading suite in one shot. Use kopern_list_templates to see available slugs.

answers.description: Onboarding answers to personalize the template (e.g. { businessName: 'Plomberie Dupont', zone: 'Paris 12-15' })

tools.name: kopern_create_grading_suite
tools.description: Create a grading suite with test cases on an agent. Each case has an input prompt and expected behavior for evaluation.

tools.name: kopern_run_grading
tools.description: Run a grading suite on an agent. Executes all test cases, evaluates with configured criteria, returns detailed scores. Uses YOUR API keys.

tools.name: kopern_run_autoresearch
tools.description: Run AutoTune optimization on an agent. Iteratively mutates the system prompt, re-grades, and keeps improvements. Returns the optimized score. Uses YOUR API keys. Can take several minutes.

suite_id.description: The grading suite ID to optimize against

target_score.description: Stop when this score is reached (0-1). Optional

max_token_budget.description: Max total tokens to spend. Optional

tools.name: kopern_create_team
tools.description: Create a multi-agent team. Agents work together in parallel, sequential (chain), or conditional (router) mode.

tools.name: kopern_run_team
tools.description: Execute a multi-agent team on a prompt. Returns each agent's output and the final combined result. Uses YOUR API keys.

prompt.description: The task/prompt to send to the team

tools.name: kopern_connect_widget
tools.description: Enable the embeddable chat widget for an agent. Returns the <script> embed code for your website.

allowed_origins.description: Allowed website domains (CORS). Empty = all origins.

tools.name: kopern_connect_telegram
tools.description: Connect an agent to Telegram via a bot. Requires a bot token from @BotFather.

tools.name: kopern_connect_whatsapp
tools.description: Connect an agent to WhatsApp Business. Requires Meta Cloud API credentials.

phone_number_id.description: WhatsApp phone number ID (from Meta dashboard)

tools.name: kopern_connect_slack
tools.description: Connect an agent to Slack. Returns an OAuth install URL to authorize in your browser (Slack requires interactive OAuth).

tools.name: kopern_connect_webhook
tools.description: Create an inbound or outbound webhook for an agent. Inbound: receive messages via HTTP POST. Outbound: send events to your URL (n8n, Zapier, Make compatible).

events.description: Events to subscribe to (outbound only): message_sent, tool_call_completed, session_ended, error

tools.name: kopern_create_pipeline
tools.description: Create a multi-step pipeline on an agent. Steps chain agents sequentially with configurable input mapping.

continue_on_error.description: Continue pipeline if this step fails. Default: false

tools.name: kopern_run_pipeline
tools.description: Execute a pipeline on a prompt. Steps run sequentially, each feeding its output to the next. Uses YOUR API keys.

tools.name: kopern_list_sessions
tools.description: List conversation sessions for an agent. Shows purpose, source, token usage, cost, timestamps. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_get_session
tools.description: Get full details of a session including message events, tool calls, and metrics. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_manage_memory
tools.description: Manage an agent's persistent memory. Actions: remember (save key-value), recall (search by query), forget (delete by key), list (all memories). No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_compliance_report
tools.description: Generate an EU AI Act compliance report for an agent. Checks Art. 6 (risk), Art. 12 (audit trail), Art. 14 (human oversight), Art. 52 (transparency). No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_get_grading_results
tools.description: Get detailed results of a grading run: per-case scores, agent outputs, criteria evaluations, improvement notes. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_list_grading_runs
tools.description: List grading runs for a suite. Shows score history, pass rates, and versions over time. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_connect_email
tools.description: Connect an agent to Gmail or Outlook for email tools (read_emails, send_email, reply_email). Requires OAuth in browser. Enables the service_email builtin tool.

tools.name: kopern_connect_calendar
tools.description: Connect an agent to Google Calendar or Microsoft Calendar for scheduling tools (list_events, create_event, etc.). Requires OAuth in browser. Enables the service_calendar builtin tool.

tools.name: kopern_get_usage
tools.description: Get token usage and cost metrics. Shows input/output tokens, cost, grading runs, and per-agent breakdown. No LLM cost.

year_month.description: Period in YYYY-MM format. Default: current month

include_history.description: Include last 6 months history. Default: false

tools.name: kopern_export_agent
tools.description: Export an agent as a portable JSON object (agent config, skills, tools, extensions, grading suites with cases). Use kopern_import_agent to re-import. No LLM cost.

tools.name: kopern_import_agent
tools.description: Import an agent from a Kopern export JSON. Creates a new agent with all skills, tools, extensions, and grading suites. No LLM cost.

data.description: The full Kopern agent export JSON (from kopern_export_agent)

prompts.name: create-agent
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide to create, configure and deploy a new AI agent on Kopern

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.description: What the agent should do (e.g. 'customer support chatbot for a restaurant')

prompts.name: grade-and-improve
prompts.description: Create a grading suite, run evaluation, and optimize an existing agent with AutoResearch

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.description: The agent to evaluate and improve

prompts.name: deploy-everywhere
prompts.description: Deploy an agent to all available channels: widget, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, webhooks
